summary: Re-verification against the post-task-057..060 spec (a475793a). Every one held. ONE genuine defect found, and it is in the correction text itself: § Next Steps & Priorities item 1 pins 'spec_fingerprint 3909f351' into spec prose as the live verification record — the orchestrator writing THIS result falsifies that sentence on contact, and restating verification-result.json's contents in spec body text duplicates an authority DEC-022 assigns to the file. That is the FR-052 class task-057 existed to eliminate, reintroduced by task-057. Build correctness is not in question anywhere; the record is again what needs work. Also observational: HEAD deployed 01:36Z has not yet been exercised by a pipeline run (last run 2026-08-06T04:00Z), but a comment-stripped diff proves its notebook changes are 100% comment/docstring with zero executable-line changes, and both notebooks parse.
